A HEALTHY verdict is not a dangerous miss here (nothing leaks or is broken), so the defect scoring (HEALTHY = false clear) and the healthy-control scoring (any finding = false positive) both misdescribe it. The check is planned only for a memory symptom; any verdict is reported informationally.
